en.title: Bread, patience and other slow proofs
en.excerpt: Notes from a year of baking the same loaf until it finally listened.
en.content:
Notes from a year of baking the same loaf until it finally listened. Same flour, same water temperature, same unhurried schedule. The failures were instructive.

Sourdough teaches you that some things cannot be rushed without consequence. The dough knows when you are impatient.

On the three hundred and ninth attempt, the crust cracked exactly right. I wrote it down and have not changed the recipe since.
en.author: June Marsk
